name: Zhangsir1724 Smart Shield
author: zhangsir

sections.description:
Zhangsir1724 Smart Shield is a powerful security plugin designed to protect your WordPress site from various attacks. It provides multiple layers of protection including Web Application Firewall (WAF), login brute-force protection, file integrity monitoring, and dangerous PHP function detection.

Key Features

  • Web Application Firewall (WAF) – Detects and blocks common attacks like SQL injection, XSS, command injection, and path traversal
  • Login Protection – Prevents brute-force attacks with configurable attempt limits and lockout durations
  • File Protection – Protects sensitive files and monitors file integrity
  • Dangerous Functions Monitor – Detects and alerts on dangerous PHP functions execution
  • Real-time Logging – Tracks all security events with detailed logs
  • Easy Configuration – User-friendly admin interface with one-click enable/disable

Security Protections

  • SQL Injection Detection
  • Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Prevention
  • Command Injection Blocking
  • Path Traversal Protection
  • Local File Inclusion (LFI) Prevention
  • Remote Code Execution (RCE) Detection
  • Brute Force Attack Prevention

Additional Info

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or transmit any user data to external servers. All security logs are stored locally in your WordPress database.

Data Storage

The plugin stores the following data in your WordPress database:
* Security settings (wp_options table)
* Blocked request logs (wp_options table)
* Login attempt records (custom table)
* Locked IP addresses (transients)

All data can be removed by deactivating and deleting the plugin.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zhangsir1724-smart-shield directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page (Zhangsir1724 Smart Shield menu) to configure.
  4. Enable the security features you need.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with caching plugins?

Yes, Zhangsir1724 Smart Shield is compatible with most caching plugins. The WAF rules are executed before caching, ensuring all requests are properly scanned.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

The plugin is optimized for performance. Security checks are lightweight and only run when necessary. The impact on site performance is minimal.

Can I use this with other security plugins?

While you can use multiple security plugins, we recommend using Zhangsir1724 Smart Shield as your primary security solution to avoid conflicts and duplicate functionality.

How do I report a security issue?

Please report any security vulnerabilities to our security team. We take security seriously and will respond promptly.
